entities.name: Hussein Bakr Abdin Hosam
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hossam Hussein Bakr Abdin is an Egyptian boxer who won a welterweight bronze at the 2007 All-Africa Games and later qualified for the 2008 Summer Olympics. He also won gold in his weight division at the African Championships in 2015 and then silver in 2017.
